nom: Dior La Mousse OFF/ON Foaming Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive mostly report no irritation, redness, or stripping and call the formula gentle, though one broke out badly and another found the fragrance a bit strong for her taste despite tolerating it fine otherwise.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some say the cleanser leaves skin hydrated and comfortable with no tightness, while others, including one who calls it a factor of her very dry skin, find it leaves their face feeling tight or a little dry after rinsing.
segments.combination: Reviewers who describe their skin as combination report clear, comfortable skin with no excess dryness, including one who is dry in winter and combination the rest of the year.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser rinses clean without leaving skin tight, stripped, or dry, and several call it hydrating; a handful still report their skin feeling dry, tight, or squeaky right after washing.
concerns.redness: Reviewers largely report no redness or irritation, including several with sensitive skin, but one reviewer says the cleanser sometimes makes her skin red.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone or breakout-prone, report no new breakouts; two reviewers did break out, one attributing it to the niacinamide in the formula and one with sensitive skin who found it too harsh.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry skin reports the cleanser treated her skin barrier well even with niacinamide in the formula, with no redness, itching, or dry patches and hydration left behind.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes her skin felt oilier than normal when this was used alone, but not when paired with a stronger cleanser first.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting, a little goes a long way
Twist-cap dispenser is fiddly to use

extraits.texte: Has horrible smell that doesn't wash off and also dries skin.

I used this product only for a couple days. It made me break out bad but I do use sensitive skin. It smelt good and definitely was thick. I would need to rinse my face a couple times because how thick it was. It is not foaming it more like shampoo or conditioner feeling. It definitely cleaned my face when I was removing old makeup off my face it didn't take long for me to remove as the wash worked right away.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first thing I noticed was the intense scent. It is very strong, very designer. Applying it felt nice and not too stripping. Once washed off, it did feel a bit dry, but not horrible. I have very dry skin so it could be a factor. I like it, but don't love it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have dry skin during the winter and combination skin throughout the rest of the year, so I'm always cautious with facial cleansers. I really liked the Dior La Mousse facial wash — it feels luxurious and cleans my skin well without leaving it tight or uncomfortable. What stood out the most for me was how it didn't make my face feel overly dry, even in colder months when my skin is at its most sensitive. It lathers nicely, rinses clean, and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed. While it's a bit of a splurge, the formula and experience make it worth trying, especially if you're looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser.

extraits.titre: Thick, rich formula, soft shine left behind
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been consistently using this for a few weeks to get a genuine impression before sharing how it"s going. Overall, am quite impressed. Packaging is durable, secure, and beautiful in its simplicity. The mousse is thick, rich, lathers into a sudsy foam fantastically, and a little goes a long way. Always great news for desired amount of time a whole product lasts. It has a clean scent that reminds me of a fresh, soft, simple ivory soap. I can safely report this Dior cleanser has treated my skin barrier well, even with niacinamide included. My take away is that it gently, effectively cleanses away makeup (easily including my impossible waterproof mascara), dirt and sweat buildup, leaving behind a softer texture that I can see a squeaky clean shine of hydration from. It does not leave my naturally leaning toward the dry end skin tight and dry, but I can feel that it's perfectly ready for a good moisturizer followup. Importantly, it has not irritated my face with bumps, redness, itching, or dry patches. My understanding of being titled OFF/ON is it cleans off makeup, impurities, microparticles and pollutants while leaving on healthy hydration, a stronger, well soothed skin barrier. It makesmperfect sense after using it. Enjoyable experience here.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using Dior facial cleanser for a few weeks and really love it! It lathers well into nice foam that easily removes all my makeup without any residue. My skin feels soft and smooth, there is no drying sensation or any irritation. My skin is sensitive and acne-prone but this cleanser works great for me. I didn't notice any new breakouts or bad reaction, my skin doesn't feel stripped off afterwards. The scent is light and amazing, it smells like fresh water lillies. The tube format is easy to use to disperse just the right amount, you don't need much and the big package size will go a long way. Dior cleanser makes my morning and evening routine feel luxurious and gives it a spa-like experience.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] There is some sort of magic in this face wash. I've had an extensive skin care routine for years but never really put much stock in the face wash. Something about this particular face wash just works so well with my skin. I look glowy-er and my skin is so clear! I am 38 with combo skin. Warning it does have a strong scent - Dior beauty products always do!
